title_en: New Bukit Kayu Hitam-Sadao Road Link Opens, Eases Cross-border Movement
summary_en: BUKIT KAYU HITAM, July 11 (Bernama) -- The new road linking the Bukit Kayu Hitam Immigration, Customs, Quarantine and Security (ICQS) Complex in Kedah with the Sadao Customs, Immigration and Border Protection (CIBP) Complex in Sabah has been completed.
